Test Scenario: Verify CMS-configured bottom nav icon auto-plays Lottie animation on cold start app launch
Preconditions: User logged in; CMS configured with one animating icon (e.g. Favourites); app force-killed; cold start
Test Data: CMS animating icon = Favourites; loop count = 2
Test Steps:
1. Force-kill the TPMA app
2. Launch app (cold start)
3. Observe bottom navigation bar
4. Identify the CMS-configured icon
Expected Result: The CMS-configured bottom nav icon (e.g. Favourites) begins playing its unselected Lottie auto-play animation immediately after app launch

Test Scenario: Verify auto-play animation completes exactly 2 loops per default CMS configuration
Preconditions: Cold start; CMS loop count = 2; animation configured for one icon
Test Steps:
1. Cold start app with loop count configured as 2
2. Count animation loop cycles on the configured icon
3. Observe icon state after final loop
Expected Result: Animation plays exactly 2 complete loops then stops

Test Scenario: Verify icon returns to static unselected state after auto-play animation completes
Preconditions: Cold start; user does not interact with animating icon; animation allowed to complete
Test Steps:
1. Cold start app
2. Allow auto-play animation to complete all configured loops without tapping
3. Observe animating icon state
Expected Result: After animation completes, the icon displays in static unselected state (no ongoing Lottie animation)

Test Scenario: Verify auto-play does not replay within same app session after initial completion
Preconditions: User completed auto-play animation once in current session; session flag set
Test Steps:
1. Complete auto-play animation on cold start
2. Navigate between bottom nav tabs
3. Background and foreground app without force-kill
4. Observe animating icon
Expected Result: Auto-play animation does NOT replay within the same app session after initial completion (per Scope: once per session)

Test Scenario: Verify tapping animating icon during animation stops Lottie immediately
Preconditions: Cold start; auto-play animation in progress on configured icon
Test Steps:
1. Cold start app and wait for animation to begin
2. Tap the animating icon before animation completes
3. Observe animation state at moment of tap
Expected Result: Lottie auto-play animation stops immediately upon user tap before completion

Test Scenario: Verify selected state Lottie plays when user taps animating icon during animation

Test Steps:
1. Cold start app
2. Tap animating Live TV icon during auto-play
3. Observe icon visual state
Expected Result: Selected state Lottie animation plays for the tapped icon

Test Scenario: Verify app navigates to tapped tab when user taps animating icon during animation

2. Tap animating My Account icon during animation
3. Observe screen content

Test Scenario: Verify tapped animating icon remains in selected highlighted state after tap
Preconditions: User tapped animating icon during animation
Test Steps:

2. Observe icon state after navigation completes
3. Wait 5 seconds without further interaction
Expected Result: Icon remains in selected (highlighted) state after tap during animation

2. Tap On Demand icon (non-animating)
3. Observe Favourites icon animation state
Expected Result: Auto-play animation on the configured icon continues playing until that icon is selected/tapped
